test_title: PYST 171: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students Lovely, Johnson, Will, Marie, Samantha and Joel are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Lovely is sitting second to the left of Johnson. Will is sitting second to the right of Johnson. Samantha is sitting third to the left of Will. Joel is sitting third to the right of Johnson. Marie is the immediate neighbour of Will and Johnson. Who is sitting between Lovely and Johnson?
solution:
Given: Six students Lovely, Johnson, Will, Marie, Samantha and Joel are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Lovely is sitting second to the left of Johnson.

2) Will is sitting second to the right of Johnson.

3) Samantha is sitting third to the left of Will.

4) Joel is sitting third to the right of Johnson.

5) Marie is the immediate neighbour of Will and Johnson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc636d7d12b4d856846453d0cf05347e02321378a98d2c20e921f2185b3a46d9.png] 

Here, 'Samantha' is sitting between Lovely and Johnson.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
